sample_question_format.description: This shows the format for questions as they are stored in the database and returned to the mobile app
sample_question_format.note: Correct answers are NOT included in the mobile app response for security. They are only used server-side for scoring.

choices_table.choice_text: The choice text (A, B, C, D, E will be managed by frontend)
choices_table.is_correct: Boolean flag (1 for correct, 0 for incorrect)

mobile_app_response_format.question_text: What is the capital of Rwanda?

correct_answer_in_database.note: This information is stored in the choices table with is_correct = 1

frontend_option_labeling.note: Option labels (A, B, C, D, E) are managed by the frontend/mobile app

example_row: What is the capital of Rwanda?
bulk_upload_csv_format.note: Correct answer column uses A, B, C, D, E to indicate which choice is correct

api_request_format.description: Format for creating/updating questions via API

create_question_request.question_text: What is the capital of France?

api_request_format.note: Each choice object must have choice_text and is_correct properties. Exactly one choice must have is_correct: true. questionImageUrl is optional.

user_registration_format.description: Format for user registration via API
